sources.name: Europe PMC publication integrity
sources.gap_addressed: Retraction publication types and correction links previously discarded.
limitations: No flag does not establish absence of retraction; review required.

sources.name: UniProtKB
sources.license_notes: CC-BY-4.0 for copyrightable data; third-party rights may apply
sources.gap_addressed: Protein identifiers, review status, taxonomy and entry versions.
limitations: Annotations do not establish drug efficacy; query scope may include nonhuman organisms.

sources.name: GWAS Catalog v2
sources.license_notes: Review current data terms before ingestion
sources.gap_addressed: Direct curated variant-trait and ancestry metadata, beyond aggregated target scores.
limitations: Use v2; v1 retired August 2026. No current summary-statistics API. Association is not causality.

sources.name: DepMap / PRISM
sources.license_notes: Release-specific terms; newer data have research/commercial-use restrictions
sources.gap_addressed: Cell-line viability and genetic dependency validation for repurposing hypotheses.
limitations: Catalog metadata endpoint is not a data download. Do not bypass CAPTCHA; pin release DOI, license, assay units and cell IDs.

sources.name: LINCS L1000 / GEO GSE70138
sources.license_notes: Inspect per-dataset terms and citation requirements
sources.gap_addressed: Experimental transcriptional responses for hypothesis generation.
limitations: Pin cell line, concentration, duration and processing level; distinguish measured from inferred genes. Signature reversal is not clinical benefit.

sources.name: CZ CELLxGENE Census
sources.license_notes: Per-dataset license and citation review required
sources.gap_addressed: Cell-type and tissue context for target expression.
limitations: Pin an LTS release and is_primary_data filter; avoid double counting cells. Expression does not establish therapeutic effect.

sources.name: ClinPGx
sources.license_notes: CC-BY-SA-4.0 plus data usage terms; CPIC content has separate terms
limitations: API documentation warns schema may change; respect 2 requests/second. No patient-specific dosing or automatic application.

sources.name: Arca FDA / Trials / PubMed
sources.license_notes: Verify provider and originating dataset terms separately
sources.gap_addressed: Discover regulatory review, approval and safety records beyond drug labels.
limitations: Mirrored source lanes do not prove complete or current coverage. Clinical-guideline lane currently reports no mirrored results.
sources.documentation_scope: Underlying FDA data authority; not an Arca backend API contract

sources.name: Genomic Intelligence splice models
sources.license_notes: Model/provider entitlement and terms not verified for backend use
limitations: Catalog lists g0-splice-bigbird, 15000-bp context and 500000-bp request maximum; predictions are not clinical variant interpretation.
sources.documentation_scope: Ensembl reference-sequence source only; provider model metadata obtained from connected list_models tool

sources.name: qBraid / IBM research compute
sources.gap_addressed: Possible later simulation benchmarking against classical baselines.
limitations: Community demos are not validated biomedical solvers. No job submission or quantum advantage established.
